question: Should ai& be accepted as a permanently supported built-in CodexBar provider rather than remaining outside the curated core provider set?
rationale: The implementation is technically bounded and has real runtime evidence, but deciding which third-party providers receive permanent core support is a repository product and maintenance commitment that code review cannot infer.

options.title: Sponsor ai& as a core provider
options.body: Approve the default-disabled API-key provider after the registration-macro repair and provenance correction.

options.title: Keep the core provider set narrower
options.body: Decline this provider direction and invite a future proposal only if the repository’s provider policy changes.

recommendation.title: Sponsor ai& as a core provider
recommendation.body: Approve the default-disabled API-key provider after the registration-macro repair and provenance correction.

likelyOwner.reason: The current head integration and repository-level product scope both point most strongly to steipete.
